title: The Quiet Songbook
author: Wendell Ravensworth
blurb: Sable Reyes, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
